name: @gestglobale/pos
description: Caisse GestGlobale — vend sur sa base locale, meme sans reseau

scripts.sonde: pnpm preparer && (xvfb-run -a electron --no-sandbox outils/sonde-natif.js; e=$?; pnpm restaurer; exit $e)
scripts.essai: pnpm preparer && (xvfb-run -a electron --no-sandbox outils/essai-caisse.js; e=$?; pnpm restaurer; exit $e)
scripts.empaqueter:windows: pnpm preparer && pnpm build && (electron-builder --win --publish never; e=$?; pnpm restaurer; exit $e)
scripts.empaqueter:linux: pnpm preparer && pnpm build && (electron-builder --linux dir --publish never; e=$?; pnpm restaurer; exit $e)
